content.what_it_is: EFDC 수치 상태를 ASCII 재시작 파일로 수집·출력하고 다시 전역 배열로 읽은 뒤 MPI broadcast와 local mapping을 수행하는 RESTART_MODULE이다. 주 재시작 입출력(Restart_Out/Restart_In, L32-L1784), 수질·퇴적·RPEM 별도 재시작(L1786-L2008), continuation 파일 복사(L2010-L2109), local-to-global 수집과 경계·SEDZLJ 매핑(L2111-L2724)을 구현한다.

unresolved: Shellfish restart state is not gathered for output: Gather_Restart_Arrays leaves the ISTRAN(4) branch as TODO at L2290-L2293, while Restart_Out writes SFL_Global and SFL2 at L128-L131. Thus master output can use stale/unpopulated global shellfish arrays; the second record also writes SFLSBOT again instead of a distinct prior-state bottom value, and Restart_In symmetrically overwrites SFLSBOT twice at L669-L670.

Restart_In reads shellfish rows into local SFL/SFL2 indexed by global LG on the master at L667-L670, then the conditional broadcast branch for ISTRAN(4) is only a placeholder at L831-L833 and the local-population branch is also empty at L984-L986. Shellfish restart values therefore do not reach nonmaster ranks and may be incorrectly indexed even on master.

Drying state read on master (ISCDRY_Global, NATDRY_Global, IDRY_Global at L590-L592) is consumed on every rank during local mapping at L878-L886, but the primary broadcast list at L760-L815 broadcasts SUB/SVB and omits all three drying arrays. Nonmaster wet/dry masks can consequently be derived from uninitialized or stale globals.

The legacy ISDRY==99 path reads ISCDRY_Global/NATDRY_Global/IDRY_Global/SUB_Global/SVB_Global only on master at L1604-L1613, then immediately maps them on all ranks at L1616-L1627 without any broadcast, repeating the same MPI inconsistency.

For restart version >=1200 with ISGOTM>0, TKE3D_Global/EPS3D_Global/GL3D_Global are read only on master at L606-L610 and used on every rank at L913-L921. No broadcasts for these three arrays appear in the communication section L760-L861, so nonmaster turbulence restart state is undefined.

The freezing-point calculation uses SAL(L,KC) at L959-L963 while the enclosing global-to-local loop is indexed by LG/LL and L is not assigned on that path. This is a use-before/stale-index error; it should use SAL(LL,KC). It can read an unrelated cell or exceed the local range.

Temperature validation is internally contradictory: the ice logic permits a negative freezing point TF and raises values only up to TF at L955-L975, but the later general loop forces TEM and TEM1 to at least zero at L1469-L1470. All physically permitted subzero restart temperatures are erased.

Bathymetry-change correction is unreachable under the condition that creates it. ISBELVC is set only in the ISRESTIOPT!=0 branch when BELTMP differs at L566-L583, but the velocity correction later requires ISRESTIOPT==0 and ISBELVC==1 at L1506-L1508. Consequently changed-bottom restart fluxes are never rescaled.

Hydraulic-structure rating-curve records have a writer/reader contract failure. Restart_Out writes SAVESUB/SAVESVB first, LOWCHORD second, and NCTL/NLOWCHORD third at L257-L259 to unit 99; Restart_In reads NLOWCHORD first, then SAVES, then LOWCHORD at L1237-L1239, and reads from unit 1 instead of UINP. In serial this consumes the wrong/unopened stream in the wrong order; MPI explicitly stops before it.

The bathymetry-change diagnostic writes IL_GL twice (`I,J` format) at L576 instead of IL_GL/JL_GL, hiding the actual row coordinate. The shallow-depth warning at L597 uses local IL/JL indexed by global LG rather than IL_GL/JL_GL, which can be out of range or report the wrong cell under MPI.

Debug restart exports compute bed thickness with KBT(LG) while iterating LG=2..LA_Global at L365-L368 and again at L393-L396. KBT is local whereas HBED_Global and the loop index are global; this can overrun local storage or truncate/sum the wrong global bed layers.

WQ_WCRST_IN's formatted path reads file identifiers L,M but stores values at loop positions WQV_Global(LG,K,...) at L1917-L1922, unlike the binary path which reads LG,K and uses them at L1934-L1938. Reordered, sparse, or mismatched formatted rows silently attach water-quality state to the wrong cell/layer instead of validating the identifiers.

Setup_Continuation_Files constructs unquoted shell commands from OUTDIR and RESTARTF-derived paths and ignores RESLOG after each SYSTEM/SYSTEMQQ call at L2050-L2101. Paths containing spaces/metacharacters can fail or alter command interpretation, and a failed copy is followed by Restart_In(1) at L2107 with no existence/success check.

The main restart format overwrites NSEDS and NSEDS2 from the file at the first global cell (L702-L705) after NMAX and array/read loop expectations were computed from the current configuration at L514-L520. A class-count mismatch can therefore partly consume the stream using old bounds and then switch bounds for subsequent cells, misaligning all following records; no compatibility check is made.
